The secrecy of that project is...''"
"''Is imperative. Which is why I've ordered anyone attempting to enter the area without my personal code to be terminated on sight.|Governor Arihnda Pryce and Grand Admiral Thrawn|}} '''Section A-2''' was a location within [[Lothal]]'s [[Imperial Armory Complex]] where the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] project was being designed. [[Morad Sumar]] confirmed to [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] that the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] had recently tightened security in the section and transferred their best workers there. Sumar determined that was the reason he and his coworkers were recruited to the labor force. Sumar helped Bridger and [[Kanan Jarrus]] [[Infiltration of the Imperial Armory Complex|inflitrate]] the [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Imperial Complex]], so they could send the stolen schematics to [[Phoenix Cell|rebel command]]. After the Jedi disguised themselves as [[stormtrooper]]s, they and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] ran across the complex, arriving outside section A2. Chopper [[stun]]ned a [[R4 courier droid]] and entered the section in the courier's place, so he could copy the Defender's blueprints, while Jarrus and Bridger stood guard. While Chopper copied the data, a [[Unidentified stormtrooper commander (Imperial Armory Complex)|stormtrooper commander]] and their two subordinates discovered the rebels' presence. They questioned the rebels asking them what they were doing there. After Jarrus informed the stormtrooper they were on guard duty, the [[corporal]] informed them their presence was highly irregular and requested their [[operating number]]s. As the stormtroopers approached the disguised rebels, Chopper exited section A2 with the Defender's schematics. Jarrus questioned the stormtrooper commander asking them if they were at [[section B-17]], to which the stormtrooper replied they were at A-2. Unconvinced with the rebels' deception, the [[trooper]]s pursued the rebels down the hallways, towards a [[turbolift]], where [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB) [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus]] called to the disguised rebels to come with him. Soon after, [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] confirmed to [[Governor of the Lothal sector|Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce|Pryce]] that an unlicensed [[droid]] accessed the [[computer]]s in section A-2. He informed Pryce that he was sure that the rebels acquired his plans for the TIE Defender as a result. Meanwhile, Kallus led the disguised rebels to a terminal where he was surprised to discover Chopper had already succeeded as a [[spy]], successfully stealing the Defender's schematics from section A2. {{Loc-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Section A-2 first appeared in "[[An Inside Man]]," the tenth episode of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]],{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/an-inside-man-episode-guide|text="An Inside Man" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} which premiered on [[December 3]], [[2016]].{{Twitter|Tcann13|status/796047493012156416|Tracy Cannobbio|quote=Hi @Stephen5228 We have new eps on 11/19, 11/26, 12/3, 12/10 then break for the holidays & back in Jan!|archivefile=File:TracyCannobbio-RebelsDates-November-8-2016.png}} ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|An Inside Man}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/an-inside-man-episode-guide|text="An Inside Man" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} {{Imo}} *{{RebelsRecon|dRcc48GmXd0|#3.09: Inside "An Inside Man" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-an-inside-man}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Capital City locations]] [[Category:Galactic Empire locations]]
